videos.title: Let's Fish TV
videos.description: Andrew Upshaw targets smallmouth bass on the St. Lawrence River in New York, continuing the Part #2 freshwater series with top-tier river action.

videos.title: Sportsman's Journal
videos.description: We head to northern Wisconsin to hunt down clear water walleyes using a tried and true technique!

videos.title: Reel Animals
videos.description: Capt. Mike and Geoff put an absolute clinic in Sarasota, Florida.

videos.title: Angling Edge Adventures
videos.description: Al Lindner and Ty Sjodin explore the west side of Lac Seul, long rumored to be the hottest walleye bite in Sunset Country. They show why.

videos.title: Road Trip Angler
videos.description: Jameson Redding hits the road to find the best fishing spots in America.

videos.title: Arkansas Great Outdoors
videos.description: We demonstrate (inadvertently) how not planning ahead can leave a fishing team stranded on a beautiful lake!

videos.title: Fishing the Midwest
videos.description: Bridget Johnson, a medic in The Air National Guard, joins the Fishing the Midwest crew for some good walleye fishing action!

videos.title: Lake Commandos
videos.description: Host Mark Courts and guest Matt Stefan wade into the world of saltwater and Texas sized redfish.

videos.title: Live Bait
videos.description: Todd and Landon Pool are fourth generation fish farmers. See a unique trotline result this week.

videos.title: National Walleye Tour
videos.description: National Walleye Tour anglers take on Lake Huron in Alpena, Michigan for the third stop of the season! Tune in to see which Pros & Co-Anglers take top honors.

videos.title: Jimmy Houston Outdoors
videos.description: Jimmy is winter time fishing in Oklahoma.

videos.title: Fishing With Roland Martin
videos.description: Roland and Tom find a spawning flat where nice 3-7 lb. bass are really hitting shiners.

videos.title: Bill Dance Outdoors
videos.description: In part 2, Bill continues to Go Big or Go Home, using a larger, slower moving bait to catch bigger bass.

videos.title: Bill Dance Saltwater
videos.description: This week Bill joins his great friend Captain Peter Deeks for big speckled sea trout and snook.

videos.title: The Fish Guyz
videos.description: Join The Fish Guyz! Captain Lain Goodwin, Earl Byrd III, and an eclectic crew of local legends showcase the best fishing and tourism the Conch Republic offers. Professional chef Cat Pfeiffer demystifies seafood with simple recipes made for home kitchens.

videos.title: Spear Life
videos.description: We head to Key West as the Spear Life crew teams up with Captain Robert Trossett for an action-packed adventure featuring big fish, shark encounters and the unique atmosphere of the Key West Songwriters Festival.

videos.title: Gale Force Twins
videos.description: Identical twins Amanda and Emily Gale host an all ladies fishing tournament on the Pacific Coast of Guatemala where giant billfish reach to the sky.

videos.title: Wild at Heart
videos.description: Kaylee chases permit in the lower keys with an up-and-coming guide, Captain Shawn McKay. With two determined anglers nothing will stand between them and their target.

videos.title: Livin' the Dream With Captain Jimmy Nelson
videos.description: Livin' the Dream follows Captain Jimmy Nelson and his wife Luiza as they travel and fish in exotic locales.

videos.title: Uncharted Waters With Peter Miller
videos.description: Peter Miller joins fishing pioneers Capt. Russell Kleppinger and Capt. Ray Rosher for a hand-cranked shot at swordfish on a 20-pound test line.

videos.title: Saltwater Underground With Nick Honachefsky
videos.description: Huge sheepshead lurk in Jersey's waters; Nick heads out with Capt. Dan Schafer to ply trophy sheep from the bridge pilings.

videos.title: Unfathomed
videos.description: Follow Capt. George in search of fish and adventure.

videos.description: Champion angler Ott DeFoe shares insight and tactics for catching largemouth bass during wild weather on a South Carolina lake.

videos.title: Catching Bass With Dustin Wilks
videos.description: Accomplished angler Dustin Wilks fishes various bass fishing locations and teaches how to find and catch more fish. Loaded with fish catches, Catching Bass with Dustin Wilks is a show that is action-packed and shows the viewer numerous techniques for catching bass. Dustin's straightforward approach coupled with his whimsical demeanor makes Catching Bass with Dustin Wilks the perfect teaching platform for anyone to be successful in bass fishing.
